expected.why: The homepage is served as an almost empty shell (4 words) and renders links to 20 internal addresses. Requested directly, every one of those 20 answers HTTP 404 with the host's "404: NOT_FOUND" page: the app routes in the browser and the host has no rewrite sending deep links to it. Corrected after re-reading the bytes: /about/vision-mission is in the sitemap and answers 404, but the homepage does not link to it, so it is not part of this claim.

The rendered homepage links to 20 internal pages whose stored status is 404. The claim covers each dead target and the one page that links to them. Corrected after re-reading the bytes: /about/vision-mission is in the sitemap and answers 404, but the homepage does not link to it, so it is not part of this claim.
These 18 URLs appear as <loc> entries in sitemap.xml and their stored status is 404. The other three dead pages (/admin, /privacy, /terms) are not in the sitemap.
The served homepage has 4 words of visible text and the rendered DOM has 523. Nothing is readable until JavaScript runs.
The rendered homepage has two <h1> elements, both reading "Solian Girls Senior School".
The homepage <title> is "Quality Education for Girls in Kenya | Solian Girls Senior School", 65 characters.
A request for /llms.txt did not return a file (the capture stored null). The homepage is the only page of this site that exists for an agent to land on; the rest answer 404.

Added after re-reading the bytes when the engine claimed it; I had cleared it too quickly. The homepage has two tel: links and a PostalAddress, and its JSON-LD types are EducationalOrganization, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList. None is LocalBusiness or a subtype, so the claim as the rule states it is true. Whether a school should add one is a judgement the finding leaves to the reader.
